articles.title: USG Board of Regents Approves FY2026 Budget Priorities
articles.description: The Board of Regents of the University System of Georgia approved budget priorities for fiscal year 2026, focusing on workforce development, research expansion, and student success initiatives.

articles.title: USG Institutions See Record Research Funding in 2025
articles.description: University System of Georgia institutions secured a record level of external research funding in fiscal year 2025, with grants from federal agencies and private foundations spanning science, engineering, health, and the humanities.

articles.title: Chancellor Sonny Perdue Highlights Workforce Initiatives at Spring Summit
articles.description: At the annual spring workforce summit, USG Chancellor Sonny Perdue outlined new programs designed to align higher education credentials with Georgia's growing technology, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing sectors.

articles.title: Georgia State University Named Among Top Public Research Universities
articles.description: Georgia State University has been recognized among the top public research universities in the Southeast for its work in student success, urban education, and health sciences research.

articles.title: USG Announces New Dual-Enrollment Expansion for High School Students
articles.description: The University System of Georgia is expanding dual-enrollment opportunities, allowing eligible Georgia high school students to earn college credit while completing their secondary education.

articles.title: USG Receives $50M Grant for STEM Workforce Pipeline
articles.description: A $50 million federal grant will support the University System of Georgia in building a comprehensive STEM workforce pipeline, focusing on underrepresented communities across the state.

articles.title: New Faculty Hiring Initiative Targets STEM and Health Sciences
articles.description: USG institutions are launching a coordinated faculty hiring initiative to recruit top talent in high-demand fields including data science, nursing, engineering, and public health.

articles.title: Georgia Tech Partners with Industry on AI Research Hub
articles.description: Georgia Institute of Technology has announced a new public-private partnership to establish an artificial intelligence research hub, expected to create hundreds of research positions and drive economic development.

articles.title: UGA Spring Enrollment Reaches All-Time High
articles.description: The University of Georgia reported its highest spring enrollment on record, reflecting growing student demand for in-state higher education and expanded program offerings.

articles.title: USG Expands Mental Health Resources Across All 26 Institutions
articles.description: The University System of Georgia is investing in expanded mental health and counseling services across all 26 of its member institutions, responding to increased student demand for well-being support.
